messages:
sam: Hey docs - customer ran into an installer failure on Private: PKCS11 socket created but installer can't open it under AppArmor. Can we add a tiny troubleshooting note + a .NET SDK example for kms unix transport and a PowerShell systemd-equivalent snippet?

yuki: Yup. AppArmor tends to block access when the unit hasn't been allowed the socket path. Suggest a 1-paragraph note: check AppArmor profile or run `aa-status` and add a simple rule example.

diane: I'll draft the copy. Minimal AppArmor troubleshooting: check audit log (`journalctl -k | grep apparmor`) and add an allowance like: `apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/local/redwood-installer` with a simple local file containing `/var/run/pkcs11.sock rw,` (mention to reload profiles). Keep it short.

sam: Also add a compact .NET example for docs (C#) so Windows/PowerShell users see both transports.

diane: Proposed C# snippet (for docs):
```csharp
// C# (.NET) example: pick unix socket for air-gapped installs
using Redwood;
var cfg = Config.Default();
cfg.KMSTransport = "unix"; // or "tcp"
cfg.KMSSocket = "/var/run/kms.sock";
using var client = new Client(cfg);
await client.HealthCheckAsync();
```

yuki: And a short PowerShell/systemd note for non-systemd Windows installs (for customers running under WSL or Windows Server), plus an example for a systemd ExecStartPre (one-liner) and a PowerShell equivalent to set permissions: `icacls C:\path\to\pkcs11.sock /grant "NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(R)"` — but keep a clear callout that sockets on Windows are different; recommend TCP there.

diane: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/942 - includes AppArmor troubleshooting paragraph, the C# snippet, a PowerShell permission recommendation, and an AppArmor local rule example.

linkbot: link-checker: flagged 1 broken anchor in /private/install.md (pkcs11-perms) - PR 942 should address it.

sam: Can you add a tiny callout: "If you must use TCP on Windows, ensure firewall allows the KMS port and prefer mTLS" ? Short sentence only.

diane: Added callout. Preview: https://deploy-preview-942--docs.redwood.ai

yuki: Preview looks fine, AppArmor note is succinct and C# snippet renders. LGTM.

linkbot: netlify: preview build passed, link checks re-run, no remaining failures.

sam: Thanks, merged. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
